programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan seeks help from psychiatrist Dr Jim. As she heals, Jim is haunted by the same disturbances when his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: Flashover
programme.desc: Based on a true story, an earthquake causes the gas pipes in an industrial park to break, resulting in explosions & fires in the area. Firefighters must fight to safeguard lives, including their own.

programme.title: My First Of May
programme.desc: Former squash champion Teng and his wife are devastated by their daughter's muscular dystrophy. Years later, the faint movement of her pinky finger gives them a small but powerful sign of hope.

programme.title: Ready o/r Knot
programme.desc: A couple who first meet at a wedding & have been together for five years, question the institution of marriage from opposing viewpoints. Should marriage always be the 'next step.'?

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: Set three years after Dragon Inn, this sequel depicts a new inn that has risen from the ashes - one staffed by treasure seekers in disguise.

programme.title: Good Game
programme.desc: A desperate internet cafe owner recruits his daughter, a washed-up action star and a failed pro gamer to form a ragtag esports team—all for a HK$500k tournament and one last, no-regrets shot.

programme.title: Wolf Pack
programme.desc: Specializing in overseas security jobs, The Wolf Pack discovers that terrorists are planning to destroy the country's energy source. Lead by Lao Diao, the pack must move out to stop them!

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Caught in an underground fight to pay off debts, talented boxer Jia Yang loses her Olympics dream and quits boxing. A decade later, Coach Li aids her comeback. Can Jia Yang resurrect her boxing dream?

programme.title: Table for Six 2
programme.desc: Bernard and Lung plan to get married when their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for all involved!

programme.title: I Did it My Way
programme.desc: As the secretive dark world of online drug trafficking increasingly targets Hong Kong, the police launches a risky and secret operation to bring down one of the most notorious drug lords in Asia.

programme.title: Leap
programme.desc: At the 2008 Beijing Olympics, former volleyball legend Lang Ping coached Team USA to a controversial win over China. She later returned to rebuild China's team and won gold at Rio 2016.

programme.title: The Panda Plan: Magical Tribe
programme.desc: Superstar Jackie Chan and panda Hu Hu are ambushed by robbers during their journey. In the chaos, they plunge off a cliff and discover a mysterious, isolated tribe hidden from the outside world.

programme.title: YOLO
programme.desc: After years of self-neglect, Le Ying decides to embrace life anew. Meeting a boxing coach sparks her desire for a fresh start. Despite the challenges ahead, she embarks on a transformative journey.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A huge hit in the HK, this typical Stephen Chow movie combines history, science fiction, martial arts & comedy elements makes it a fun watch.

programme.title: Time Still Turns the Pages
programme.desc: High school teacher Cheng finds a suicide note, triggering his childhood memories. He strives to prevent the suicide tragedy, while dealing with his wife's divorce request and his father's illness.

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians: Wind Rises in the Desert
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma escorts the most wanted fugitive across the desert to Chang'an, only to be drawn into a plot that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Set in 2020 during the outbreak of COVID-19, the movie features interconnected stories of three women's lives as they navigate the uncertain future amongst their respective friends and families.

programme.title: Out of Order
programme.desc: A successful lawyer's secret affair turns into a nightmare when a corpse unexpectedly turns up in the hotel room, triggering a desperate cover-up that spirals into uncontrollable chaos.

programme.title: The Prosecutor
programme.desc: A young man is wrongly convicted of drug trafficking. A former cop turned prosecutor believes in his innocence and launches an investigation, risking his life and career to find the true perpetrator.

programme.title: I Still Remember
programme.desc: An uplifting sports drama focusing on a property agent who leads an aimless, unfulfilling life & his P.E teacher, as they seek to find purpose in their lives.

programme.title: Project Gutenberg
programme.desc: The HK police is hunting for a counterfeiting gang led by a mastermind known as Painter. They recruit artist Lee Man to help in their quest, but the real identity of Painter surprises everyone.

programme.title: 8 Bucks Tycoon
programme.desc: When a struggling painter receives a magical wallet that endlessly produces RM8 notes, his life transforms from hardship to luxury. However, is this miracle truly a blessing or a hidden curse?

programme.title: Hong Kong Family
programme.desc: A family torn apart 8 years ago during a disastrous winter solstice dinner reunites when their cousin returns home from England, hoping to mend relations after things had fallen apart.

programme.title: Cesium Fallout
programme.desc: Hong Kong's survival is at risk due to a radiation leak. A fire brigade is assigned to stop cesium fallout by entering the radiation zone. Facing this unprecedented disaster, can they save the city?

programme.title: My Blue Summer
programme.desc: Zhi has been secretly in love with high school classmate Nan from the moment they met. They finally become close friends when they entered the same university, but will Zhi ever confess his feelings?

programme.title: Crypto Storm
programme.desc: ICAC officer Lok sets up a special team to investigate a corruption case involving a bank's top executive's use of cryptocurrency to manipulate the trading market.

programme.title: Tristar
programme.desc: A young priest striving to save lost souls crosses paths with a prostitute seeking refuge in the church to escape her debts, they get entangled in a CID investigation into a prostitution ring.

programme.title: Under Current
programme.desc: The death of a charity's CFO and a missing donation force lawyer Ma into an alliance with a police officer. Together, they risk everything to uncover the charity's darkest secrets and seek justice.

programme.title: Reunion Dinner
programme.desc: When an engaged couple is requested to invite their parents for a CNY client event, the fiance - who is estranged from his mother, fakes a family. However, things spiral out of control.

programme.title: The Moon Thieves
programme.desc: A crooked watch dealer gathers a team of thieves to steal three luxury watches in Tokyo. Their plan alters upon finding the legendary 'Moonwatch', leading to a perilous heist amidst a yakuza pursuit.

programme.title: MUMU
programme.desc: Mumu connects her deaf father to the outside world, but their peaceful life is disrupted when she must adapt and fit in to the hearing world, while her father is ensnared by a gang to commit crime.

programme.title: Leap
programme.desc: At the 2008 Beijing Olympics, former volleyball legend Lang Ping coached Team USA to a controversial win over China. She later returned to rebuild China's team and won gold at Rio 2016.

programme.title: New Police Story
programme.desc: A sozzled police inspector (Jackie Chan) must pull himself up again after a bungled mission causes his entire team to be wiped out.

programme.title: Our Crazy Adventures
programme.desc: Before graduation, five high school friends decide to do something unforgettable and take on a seemingly impossible challenge - winning a crucial basketball game that could change their lives.

programme.title: Back Home
programme.desc: Wing, who can see ghosts since young, discovers that the visions that once haunted him have become worse in his home. Caught between the living and dead, Wing must bring the truth to light to be free.

programme.title: Love After Love
programme.desc: Marking the 3rd Eileen Chang adaptation directed by Ann Hui, this film is set in pre-WW2 Hong Kong, where a young girl ends up working for her aunt seducing rich & powerful men.

programme.title: Caught In Time
programme.desc: Based on a string of real robberies and murder cases, a detective engages in a mouse-and-cat game with the 'Eagle Gang', a group of sophisticated, well-trained and ruthless robbers.

programme.title: Hell Hole
programme.desc: The movie features three horror stories in different era, revolving around a pregnant woman, a bullied boy who committed suicide, and some company staff who open a box of used clothes.

programme.title: Resurrection
programme.desc: In a world without dreams, a monster wanders through a vanishing dreamworld. A woman who can see its hidden visions ventures deep into its dreams to seek the buried truth.

programme.title: Go For Broke
programme.desc: With his family destroyed by drug dealers, Zhang Yao teams up with detective An to take down the drug lords. As the revenge plot unfolds, do they share a common foe or harbour personal agendas?

programme.title: Love for All Seasons
programme.desc: Womanizer Tiger Hung arrives in Mount Emei to get the cure of his illness. May is the only woman who is capable to do so, but Tiger has to break her heart first before she gains the healing power.

programme.title: The Hedgehog
programme.desc: Wang's odd behavior and quirky ideas make him a social outcast. When he meets his teenage nephew who is ashamed of his stutter, the two develop a special friendship through mutual understanding.

programme.title: Detective Chinatown 1900
programme.desc: In 1900s San Francisco, the murder of a white woman in Chinatown ignites public outrage. Two Chinese detectives race against time to uncover the true killer amid mounting tension and danger.

programme.title: Raging Fire
programme.desc: Starring Donnie Yen, Nicholas Tse, an inspector discovers that the team of masked thugs who killed his co-workers are led by a former fellow cop who was forced into a life of crime by him.

programme.title: CJ7
programme.desc: When a poor laborer picks up a toy for his son from a dumpster, the events that follow teach them about the true nature of family and things money can't buy.

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians: Wind Rises in the Desert
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma escorts the most wanted fugitive across the desert to Chang'an, only to be drawn into a plot that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Wu Kong
programme.desc: Eddie Peng charms as possibly the most handsome Monkey King alongside Shawn Yue & Ni Ni in this fantasy-action-adventure film.

programme.title: Article 20
programme.desc: Prosecutor Han Ming battles a case of intentional injury, risking all for justice. In a gripping finale, he transforms it into a fight for fairness, defending what is right.

programme.title: Death Notice
programme.desc: The Police sets up a special task force to track down a serial killer who leaves death notices stating when, how and who he will murder. In the process, they expose an even bigger conspiracy behind.

programme.title: Lost Love
programme.desc: Mei tries to get over her young son's death by becoming a foster parent. Her dedication to the children leads her to neglect her husband. Will the couple be able to salvage their relationship?

programme.title: Fox Hunt
programme.desc: Fraudster Dai resurfaces in Paris after seven years on the run. The Chinese Fox Hunt Team is on a cross-border mission to recover stolen assets and uncovers shocking secrets during the manhunt.

programme.title: Rob N Roll
programme.desc: A ruthless bandit plots a major heist which is joined by two dispirited men inadvertently. Their ad-hoc and dramatic robbery lands them in a fierce police pursuit, putting their lives on the line!

programme.title: Ne Zha 2
programme.desc: After a catastrophe, the souls of Ne Zha and Ao Bing are saved, but their bodies will soon dissipate. Master Tai Yi seeks to restore them with the Seven-Coloured Lotus, hoping to change their destiny.

programme.title: OMG! Mom's Big News
programme.desc: A mother in her 50s unexpectedly becomes pregnant, turning her family's quiet life upside down. As they prepare for the baby's arrival, chaos and laughter follow, teaching them love and acceptance.

programme.title: Crisis Negotiators
programme.desc: Negotiator Wai is framed for murder. He takes hostages at the police station and demands talk with a former negotiator. As they engage in a tense battle of wits, their perspectives gradually shift.

programme.title: Chilli Laugh Story
programme.desc: Coba turns his mother's chili sauce into a trendy commodity during the pandemic, with the help of the whole family. The business booms online, bringing them unexpected success and unity.

programme.title: Dust to Dust
programme.desc: A blurred figure in a news clip prompts retired cop Wang Shou Yue to reinvestigate a cold case where the mastermind gets tipped off and escapes. A battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: True Love For Once In My Life
programme.desc: Sabrina's deep love for Andrew is shattered by his affair which ends their marriage. Years later, she returns to care for him as he is diagnosed with cancer, believing that true love comes only once.

programme.title: Life Must Go On
programme.desc: When the midnight gymnasium programme for wayward teenage girls is at risk of closing down due to funding, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match to save it.

programme.title: The Kid From The Big Apple
programme.desc: This heartwarming box office smash captures how a little Chinese girl, raised in New York, begins to discover her roots when she visits Malaysia.

programme.title: The White Storm 3: Heaven or Hell
programme.desc: Two undercover cops successfully develop a brotherly bond with a Thai drug lord. When the police busts the syndicate, the drug lord discovers that there is betrayal within his circle of trust...

programme.title: All's Well End's Well Too
programme.desc: Another super comedy directed by Clifton Ko about more farcical couplings, mistaken identities, infidelities, and arranged marriages set in the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: The Narrow Road
programme.desc: The owner of a small cleaning company, Chak, experiences a tough time during the pandemic. When he employs single mother Candy as his assistant, she became his saving grace.

programme.title: Red Line
programme.desc: A former professional racer falls into despair after causing his brother's death. He meets Dr. Hui & becomes an ambulance driver. Meanwhile, his friends uncover the truth behind his brother's accident.

programme.title: An Abandoned Team
programme.desc: Uncle Jia is bad tempered and lives alone. He decides to end his life as he feels hopeless but is saved by a stray dog and an animal welfare volunteer, allowing him to rediscover his purpose in life.

programme.title: True Love For Once In My Life
programme.desc: Sabrina's deep love for Andrew is shattered by his affair which ends their marriage. Years later, she returns to care for him as he is diagnosed with cancer, believing that true love comes only once.

programme.title: All U Need is Love
programme.desc: When a luxury hotel in Hong Kong suddenly becomes a Coronavirus superspreader, guests & the staff are faced with a 14-day trial they may not survive.

programme.title: Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: A family running a Chinese dessert shop faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. This heartfelt journey reveals the strength of family bonds, sacrifices, and resilience.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A huge hit in the HK, this typical Stephen Chow movie combines history, science fiction, martial arts & comedy elements makes it a fun watch.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A traffic accident that resulted in a taxi driver being blinded inexplicably connects a group of unrelated people together, including blind masseurs from a massage center, a young man & a couple.

programme.title: Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In
programme.desc: Young Chan Lok Kwun accidentally stumbles into the dangerous Kowloon Walled City, subsequently finding purpose amid chaos and gaining wisdom while becoming one of the City's protectors.

programme.title: Bodyguards and Assassins
programme.desc: Winner of 8 HKFA awards & featuring an all-star cast, this film depicts an elite team guarding Dr Sun Yat Sen in Hong Kong, as he discusses plans to overthrow the Qing dynasty.

programme.title: Cliff Walkers
programme.desc: Zhang Yi Mou's first spy thriller follows four Communist Party special agents who embark on a secret mission in the Japanese puppet state of Manchukuo - only to be sold out by a traitor.

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Yam Tai Foon, a wealthy man is unhappy with his son's failed marriage and Kwai's dream of being a comic artist. He pins hopes on his daughter, On, but she returns from France with wild Ruberto.

programme.title: The Kid From The Big Apple 2: Before We Forget
programme.desc: Sarah and her mother return to Malaysia to spend time with her retired grandfather. When they discover his early signs of dementia, they face the challenges together while cherishing their moments.

programme.title: Cloudy Mountain
programme.desc: As a decade-long tunnel project reaches completion, an earthquake strikes, forcing a retired soldier & his son to stop the disasters at the source, or risk the community - and the tunnel.

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan seeks help from psychiatrist Dr Jim. As she heals, Jim is haunted by the same disturbances when his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: Everything Under Control
programme.desc: During a diamond heist, Jelly steals the loot and flees, with his other cohorts hot on his heel. They stumble onto a remote village with strange villagers and mysterious eerie occurrences.

programme.title: Detective Vs. Sleuths

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: A nightclub owner (Peter Chen Ho) has his way with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Also starring Lily Ho, Chin Ping.

programme.title: The Crimson Charm
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po and Chang Yi play a noble swordsman and a one-armed swordswoman who find themselves up against the evil Crimson Charm gang of thieves and thugs.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: Kung fu idols Wang Yu, Lo Meng and Loh Lieh star in this comedy set in a Shaolin temple where Hung Hsi-kuan and Fang Shih-yu become disciples.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Featuring the unforgettable song Country Road, Shaw's Huangmei Opera stars Ivy Ling Po and tells the tale of a poor student engaged to a billionaire's daughter.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Be tickled by the slippery efforts of three pickpockets, so adept at their chosen skill that they even manage to fleece three beauties of their underwear!

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: This Yuan Dynasty tale tells of the Sacred Fire sect, Wu Tang clan, O Mei's disciples, a sacred book, and the destruction of Shaolin.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: Seven seductive Spiders lie in wait for our faithful heroes in the third installment of the Shaw Brothers adaptation of Journey to the West.

programme.title: Demon of the Lute
programme.desc: Go on a courageous quest with Hsiao Feng-ling and her classmate, as they try to capture the lute demon Chin Mo and send him back to the netherworld.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: This heartwarming 1963 musical from Shaw Brothers tells the tale of a beautiful shepherdess, whose own problems drag her into a love triangle.

programme.title: The Black Butterfly
programme.desc: A waitress, who is secretly the outlaw Black Butterfly, steals from the rich and gives to the poor but picking the wrong targets sets the law on her heels.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Following the lives of three downtrodden, but resilient outcasts, John Lo Mar's gritty social drama paints a sense of realism rarely seen in Hong Kong movies.

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2
programme.desc: The Emperor develops a more deadly Flying Guillotine and trains a squad of women to combat the 'Iron Umbrella' and a band of rebels.

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: This drama centres on the seductive Judy. A woman with a rich husband, she also has two lovers who happen to be brothers!

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: A grateful convict becomes his prison officer's defender after he learns that the officer's restaurant has been taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: This three-film anthology collectively offers up a captivating examination of human obsession and love.

programme.title: The Spiritual Boxer
programme.desc: A young man and his sifu earn a living as pseudo-ghost catchers until his sifu is arrested and an honest gal becomes his new companion.

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: After Ah Niu gets out of jail, he gets involved again with his crooked Uncle Chou and caught in other rackets and silly situations.

programme.title: The Lizard
programme.desc: A Robin Hood-like burglar must outwit the corrupt police chief who seeks to unmask him. Starring Yueh Hua, Connie Chan Po Chu.

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: Award-winning director Chang Cheh depicts the struggle of the Shaolin monasteries when the Ching Dynasty sets trap to separate and destroy them.

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: When Fang returns from the U.S. to see Rose but starts eyeing her old friend's fiance, Rose shows that she has a thorny side.

programme.title: The Gambling Syndicate
programme.desc: When a young provincial detective seeks to take down a local gambling syndicate with the help of two convicts, will they succeed?

programme.title: The Mad Monk (1977)
programme.desc: The Mad Monk rushes around saving hawkers from crumbling walls and bullies, recovering stolen money and punishing a ruthless court official and his son.

programme.title: Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Director Ching Siu-tung won international acclaim for this tale of an underachiever who is assigned to unlock the secret of the gibbon fists tactic.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: Families win and lose fortunes overnight while neighbours swindle each other as stock as speculation madness takes over Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Black Enforcer
programme.desc: When Lung, the Black Enforcer, is forced to house a killer named Fei during a snowstorm, Fei's gang comes for him. Fei kills Lung's mother and sister, triggering a fearsome vendetta.

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: From veteran director Li Han-hsiang comes this fascinating period drama, starring Li Kun as the ingenious Lord Liu, who is much envied by the Emperor.

programme.title: Men From the Monastery
programme.desc: The story of Shaolin firebrands Fang Shih-yu, Hung I-kuan, and Hu Huei-chien comes to life in Chang Cheh's rousing kung fu saga.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: An emperor's obsession with his consort distracts him, allowing his cruel prime minister who also happens to be his consort's brother, to run the nation.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: Choreographed by Tang Chia, this film is an entertaining combination of eye-popping martial arts' moves and thrilling 'Sherlock Holmes' investigations. Stars Liu Yu Pu, Derek Yee.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This drama takes on a group of young people who get entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Take a vacation with sexy Lily Ho and Jimmy Lin Chong on a whirlwind tour of Southeast Asia in one of Shaw Brothers most lively 1960's musical romances.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: In this twisted comedy, a gambling game between a rookie con artist and an experienced flimflam man has life or death repercussions.

programme.title: The Golden Sword
programme.desc: After a kidnapped swordsman is surprisingly rescued by the father he had been looking for, he also learns about his mother from him.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: Actress Li Li Hua, star of over 60 films since 1947, beautifully portrays the disgraced wife of a peddler in the final days of the Ching Dynasty.

programme.title: Duel for Gold
programme.desc: Famed director Chor Yuen has three pairs of cunning crooks on a quest to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House but one is undercover.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: Based on a famed Chinese opera, this melodramatic film depicts the romance between Zhang Sheng, an impoverished scholar, and Ying Ying, who is from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Death Duel
programme.desc: An ace swordsman fights evil, rescues women and takes part in duels to the death.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: Three sisters (the quietest and most filial of whom is played by Cheng Pei Pei) attempt to sing and dance their way to happiness.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: A pillar of the Qing establishment kills his blood brother to steal the man's wife. Also starring David Chiang.

programme.title: Inside the Forbidden City
programme.desc: This film marks the Shaw Brothers' quintessential 'Huangmei Opera' costume drama, with a superb performance from Ivy Ling Po and Chin Feng.

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: A wanna-be-detective/swordsman gets more than he bargained for when investigating the disappearance of some martial artists.

programme.title: Return of the Dead
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang's dark offering depicts the destructive effects of lust as narrated by three psychiatric patients in an asylum.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: A swordsman (David Chiang) is moved to fight back after the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend murdered by a gang.

programme.title: The Invincible Fist
programme.desc: A village's dedicated chief constable falls in love with the blind daughter of a havoc-wreaking bandit.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: A hothead (Wang Chung) is tempted by the dark side in this coming-of-age tale which centres on c. 1970s lower-class Hong Kong teens.

programme.title: Clan of the White Lotus
programme.desc: A hero (Gordon Liu Chia hui) must learn 'Embroidery Fist' and acupuncture to counter a villain's (Lo Lieh) deadly fight techniques.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: What starts off as a musical romp turns into something more akin to a Shakespearean tragedy than a beach-babe party. Starring Ching Li.

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: Tu Ku, having mastered the Silkworm skills, heads for Wu Tang to challenge Yun but finds him gone. However, the leader of the Ega Clan issues a challenge.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Pat Ting Hung, Carrie Ku Mei and Li Hsiang Chun star in this delightful tale of mistaken identities caused by monogrammed handkerchiefs.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Daring Sung Dynasty must fight their way out of trap after trap and band together to save the prime minister.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: The Monk, Monkey, Friar Sand and Pig find themselves in a realm where women can only give birth to women unless loved by a man.

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: In this wuxia film, two rival swordsmen vie with a power-hungry villain to possess the dangerous 'Peacock Dart'.

programme.title: Love Without End (1961)
programme.desc: This classic romance stars Linda Lin and Kwan Shan, capturing a touching love story between a famous nightclub singer and a young architect.

programme.title: The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: A virtuous lone swordsman who is not without individual weaknesses (Ti Lung) finally decides that it's payback time.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: This is the first of four related Shaw Brothers film adaptations of the legendary Journey To The West.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns to find his ruthless brother has taken over the family business and imprisoned their sister. Now, Hu and his sister must fight to get their lives back.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: In this mind-blowing sequel to the Shaw Brothers' horror hit, zombies run amok, driving doctors to seek a natural cause while the actual one may be supernatural.

programme.title: Love Without End (1970)
programme.desc: This shot-in-colour remake of the classic black-and-white drama has Jenny Hu in the tragic role made famous by Linda Lin Dai.

programme.title: Temple of the Red Lotus
programme.desc: When the family that a man named Wu (Jimmy Wang Yu) marries into comes under repeated attack, he suspects that his in-laws are bandits.

programme.title: The Crimson Charm
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po and Chang Yi play a noble swordsman and a one-armed swordswoman who find themselves up against the evil Crimson Charm gang of thieves and thugs.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: A detective's son's attempt to punish a swindler leads to him and his father having their own face-off. Starring Jimmy Wang Yu.

programme.title: The Fantastic Magic Baby
programme.desc: Go on a quest with the Monkey King, Goddess of Mercy and Dragon Girl, as they battle Hung, the son of the Ox Demon to save Tang Tseng, the Holy Pilgrim.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical production features George Lam in a humorous tale of a man who seeks love and success in a world of TV commercials, along with his two friends.

programme.title: That Fiery Girl
